title: Quote
purpose: Read an issued quote, inspect its issued versions, and accept or decline the current eligible version.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Sign in with an active client account. Every page, selection and action is limited to the client attached to your account, including work created by other users for the same client. Staff accounts cannot use these portal pages. Another client’s record is treated as missing.

sections.title: State and version selection
paragraphs: Only issued versions are available; staff drafts and withdrawn quotes are unavailable. Latest issued is selected initially. Versions links select an older document; an unknown version request falls back to latest issued. Older selections display Replaced and Show the current version. The tables have no search or pagination.

Accepted shows decision version, date/time and optional reference, and allows the accepted quote to be linked to a sample submission. Declined shows the decision version/date; the laboratory may revise it. Being revised means the laboratory is working on a draft and decisions are unavailable. Expired asks you to request reissue. These banners describe the current quote state while the document shows the selected issued version.

items.label: Quote number · version
items.description: Identifies the quote and selected version. Its title describes the work. Drafts use current names; issued versions retain the title, client and project names recorded at issue.

items.label: Prepared for
items.description: Client and optional project covered by this version. An absent optional project is not filled from a later draft.

items.label: Issued
items.description: Issue date for this version, or Not issued for a staff draft.

items.label: Valid until
items.description: Last calendar date an issued version is open for a client decision, using the laboratory date. Expired appears after that date while the quote is Issued.

items.label: Standard turnaround
items.description: Stated business days from receipt, or Not stated. This does not itself set an order delivery target or an analytical holding time.

items.label: Description
items.description: Stored text for the test, fee or discount. A test’s default identifies analyte, method/version, matrix and analytical unit.

items.label: Type
items.description: Test, Fee or Discount / adjustment describes the charge.

items.label: Qty
items.description: Positive whole-number multiplier, such as the number of samples quoted.

items.label: Unit price
items.description: Exact USD amount per line unit. Discounts/adjustments are zero or negative; test and fee prices are non-negative.

items.label: Amount
items.description: Computed quantity multiplied by stored unit price, in USD.

items.label: Total (USD)
items.description: Exact sum of amounts including discounts; cannot be negative.

items.label: Scope and assumptions / Terms
items.description: Client-visible text for this version. Shown only when supplied and frozen when issued.

items.label: Version
items.description: Open a previously issued version; laboratory drafts are excluded. The selected version is marked.

items.label: Issued
items.description: Issue date/time for that version.

items.label: Total (USD)
items.description: Exact stored total for that version.

items.label: Your purchase order or reference
items.description: Optional reference up to 120 characters, recorded with acceptance and visible to laboratory staff.

items.label: I accept these prices and terms for this laboratory work.
items.description: Required explicit confirmation for acceptance. Review the displayed version before checking.

items.label: Accept version
items.description: Record acceptance for the displayed current issued version, your identity, time and optional reference. It becomes available as an Accepted quote on submission forms. This action does not create a submission, order, physical receipt or report.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required explanation for the laboratory.

items.label: Decline version
items.description: Record decline of the current version with actor, time and reason. The laboratory may subsequently revise it; this page has no undo decision action.

items.label: Print
items.description: Open browser printing of the quote; does not change its state.

items.label: Quotes
items.description: Return to your client’s quote directory.

items.label: Accept / Decline availability
items.description: Both decision sections appear only for the latest issued version while Issued and not past its valid-until date. Decisions remain possible through that date using the laboratory date. Older, Being revised, Accepted, Declined and Expired versions cannot be decided on.

items.label: Validation and changed versions
items.description: Invalid input reopens the form with inline errors and typed values. A reissued version causes refusal: current version is shown, typed reference/reason is retained and acceptance confirmation must be made again. If state changes so decisions are no longer available, contact the laboratory; no decision is carried to another version. Repeating a completed identical acceptance/decline does not create a second decision.

items.label: Accept version / Decline version dialog
items.description: With enhanced page controls, open the corresponding action form in a dialog. Maximize / Restore size changes its size. Close form or Cancel leaves without submitting; if prompted, Keep editing resumes and Discard changes leaves. Wait for an in-progress decision to complete.
